complexity.notes: The leftover `print(start, end)` debug line writes to stdout on every iteration and should be removed. Wrapping the feasibility sum in a list comprehension materializes n integers needlessly; passing a generator to sum (drop the brackets) makes auxiliary space O(1). `math.ceil(pile/k)` could be the integer-only `(pile + k - 1) // k`, which avoids any float conversion for very large piles.
complexity.summary: Binary search over the eating speed k in [0, max(piles)+1], testing feasibility each step by summing ceiling divisions over all piles; the k == 0 midpoint is guarded explicitly.
